newsitem.title: USA: Bank of Algeria's Keramane sees GDP at 4.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Algeria's Keramane sees GDP at 4.0 pct.

text.p: Algeria's economic growth rate is estimated at 4.0 percent in 1996 after rising 4.3 percent in 1995, said Abdelouahab Keramane, governor of the Bank of Algeria.

"Economic growth, in terms of real GDP increase, reached 4.3 percent in 1995 and is estimated at 4.0 percent in 1996," Keramane told business executives at a Citibank conference on Wednesday in New York.
Bank of Algeria's governor Keramane said agriculture, as well as the hydrocarbon sector and the construction sector, contributed to a large extent to the economic growth performance.
